registration.detail: Registered on init whenever Fair Calendar Button is active. It does not need Fair Events.

minimal.title: Timed one-off event
minimal.description: A single two-hour event. The page title and permalink become the calendar entry's title and link.

recurring.title: Weekly recurring event with location
recurring.description: Six weekly occurrences, with a description and location added to the calendar entry.

all-day.title: Multi-day all-day event
all-day.description: An all-day event spanning three days, using date-only values.
